name: Hanamaru Remon
source:
The fifth sister.

She is a kind, mild-mannered and beautiful older sister.  She sometimes gives men around her the wrong impression. She is extremely affectionate with her younger brother, she wants to take care of him in any way possible.

She also has a tendency to make up her mind on anything making it hard to persuade her. She also has a very poor sense of taste and often makes the mistake of eating the wrong food or messing up anything she cooks.

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/ane&boin/chara/remon.htm]official site[/url]]
